titulo.alumno: A decision is postponed · Society and diverse needs

intro: Part 3: a decision is postponed. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In a public discussion, identify the groups affected and the reasons for each position. A proposal is not yet a decision; notice verbs such as «foreslår», «beslutter» and «undersøger».
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.alumno: That is why the decision is postponed until next month.
